name: UltraBlur
description: Plex-identical UltraBlur ambient corner colors extracted from item artwork, with an auto-injected web client script and a REST API for native clients.
overview: Plex-style ambient gradients for Jellyfin detail pages.

versions.changelog: New GET /UltraBlur/Colors/Url for TMDB images outside the library (Seerr titles); image.tmdb.org only, cached by URL.
New GET /UltraBlur/Colors/Url for TMDB images outside the library (Seerr titles); image.tmdb.org only, cached by URL.

- Fix: the web gradient never showed. It was painted under jellyfin-web's opaque .backgroundContainer, and the script read camelCase keys while Jellyfin returns PascalCase
- Gradient now fills the detail page background; title ribbon made transparent, banner fades into it
- Follows SPA navigation (pushState) and clears on non-detail pages
- Separate Jellyfin 12 build (net10.0)
